title: Example 20-13: Italics and Capitals with Diacritics

illustrates.quote: Follow print for emphasis or capital letters appearing in diacritic notation. (See UEB, §4, Letters and Their Modifiers and §8.8, Choice of Capitalized Indicators.)

blocks.features: Line 1: 'th' in italics. Line 2: 'th' in italics and ligatured. Line 3: 'TH' in capitals. Line 4: 'TH' with a cross-bar through the T
